Expand regulations based on the management status field

Source: R/function-mstatus.R
expand_status.Rd

Expand each regulation based on the start and end dates while incorporating the dates for the recurring action using the management status field. The management status may be once, seasonal, monthly recurring, weekly recurring, or daily recurring. However, daily recurring regulations are not being called at this time. In this function, the management type needs to be specified.

Usage

expand_status(data = fishhist, y)

Arguments

data

A dataframe (default=fishhist).

y

Management type.

Value

A dataframe where the management status is expanded for the selected management type and each represents a day within a time series. The status is formatted into wide to view how regulations with differing status types are overwritten depending on the FR Citation.

The additional columns include the following. The fields in bold are the most important indicating the rule in effect for each date:

FieldData TypeDescription
date_sequenceDateDate within time series
TIME_oneChrTime for regulation with status ONCE
CLUSTER_oneIntCluster ID for regulation with status ONCE
REG_ID_oneNumRegulation ID for regulation with status ONCE
FR_CITATION_oneChrFR Citation for regulation with status ONCE
VALUE_oneChrValue for regulation with status ONCE
VALUEUNITS_oneChrValue units for regulation with status ONCE
VALUETYPE_oneChrValue type for regulation with status ONCE
VALUERATE_oneChrValue rate for regulation with status ONCE
TIME_weeklyChrTime for regulation with status WEEKLY
CLUSTER_weeklyIntCluster ID for regulation with status WEEKLY
REG_ID_weeklyNumRegulation ID for regulation with status WEEKLY
FR_CITATION_weeklyChrFR Citation for regulation with status WEEKLY
VALUE_weeklyChrValue for regulation with status WEEKLY
VALUEUNITS_weeklyChrValue units for regulation with status WEEKLY
VALUETYPE_weeklyChrValue type for regulation with status WEEKLY
VALUERATE_weeklyChrValue rate for regulation with status WEEKLY
TIME_seasonalChrTime for regulation with status SEASONAL
CLUSTER_seasonalIntCluster ID for regulation with status SEASONAL
REG_ID_seasonalNumRegulation ID for regulation with status SEASONAL
FR_CITATION_seasonalChrFR Citation for regulation with status SEASONAL
VALUE_seasonalChrValue for regulation with status SEASONAL
VALUEUNITS_seasonalChrValue units for regulation with status SEASONAL
VALUETYPE_seasonalChrValue type for regulation with status SEASONAL
VALUERATE_seasonalChrValue rate for regulation with status SEASONAL
TIME_monthlyChrTime for regulation with status MONTHLY
CLUSTER_monthlyIntCluster ID for regulation with status MONTHLY
REG_ID_monthlyNumRegulation ID for regulation with status MONTHLY
FR_CITATION_monthlyChrFR Citation for regulation with status MONTHLY
VALUE_monthlyChrValue for regulation with status MONTHLY
VALUEUNITS_monthlyChrValue units for regulation with status MONTHLY
VALUETYPE_monthlyChrValue type for regulation with status MONTHLY
VALUERATE_monthlyChrValue rate for regulation with status MONTHLY
FR_CITATIONChrMaximum FR Citation across all status types (ONCE, WEEKLY, SEASONAL, and MONTHLY). The maximum FR Citation indicates the most recent FR
TIMEChrTime that corresponds to the maximum FR Citation
VALUEChrValue that corresponds to the maximum FR Citation
VALUEUNITSChrValue units that corresponds to the maximum FR Citation
VALUETYPEChrValue type that corresponds to the maximum FR Citation
VALUERATEChrValue rate that correspond to the maximum FR Citation

Examples

expand_status(fishhist, "FISHING YEAR")
